interactions.title: Fausto’s challenge and the crown’s transfer
lines: DM: 7 in the robe of the Chardonian Legion, a gray knight in full plate armor, his face hidden behind his helmet, a purple mist hanging around his armor, and Fausto, his young, handsome face twisted in rage, the iron and black iron and gray, the Crown of Purity on his head, grim determination and confidence in his eyes as he screams in rage: “You’ll pay for the arrogance of what you’ve done, thinking to challenge our rightful King and Emperor.
